2607.26787.title: Property-driven Causal Abstractions for Markov Decision Processes
2607.26787.paper_summary: Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are widely used as decision-making models, commonly specified over factored state spaces through state variables and their valuations. The exponential blowup in the number of states renders many reasoning tasks in MDPs challenging. Abstractions are promising techniques to reduce MDPs and thus mitigate scalability issues. In this work, we introduce a notion of causality on factored MDPs and a novel property-driven causal abstraction technique that retains many characteristics of the original MDP model. For this, we rely on causal relations over state variable predicates and identify those states that share the same reasons for fulfilling or violating a given abstraction property. We theoretically and empirically compare various causal MDP abstractions using different model types such as MDPs, interval MDPs, or stochastic games. Our evaluation demonstrates the potential of our approach: For several standard benchmarks, we obtain small abstractions that allow us to compute near-optimal policies for the original MDP. Furthermore, our causal abstractions often generalize to related large-scale MDP models.
2607.26787.paper_summary_zh: 馬可夫決策過程（MDPs）被廣泛用作決策模型，通常通過狀態變數及其評估在分解的狀態空間中指定。狀態數量的指數級增長使得許多MDP中的推理任務變得具有挑戰性。抽象化是一種有前景的技術，可以減少MDP，從而緩解可擴展性問題。在這項工作中，我們引入了在分解MDP上因果性的概念，以及一種新穎的基於屬性的因果抽象技術，該技術保留了原始MDP模型的許多特徵。為此，我們依賴於狀態變數謂詞之間的因果關係，並識別那些共享滿足或違反給定抽象屬性的相同原因的狀態。我們理論上和實證上比較了使用不同模型類型（如MDP、區間MDP或隨機遊戲）的各種因果MDP抽象。我們的評估展示了我們方法的潛力：對於幾個標準基準，我們獲得了小的抽象，這使我們能夠為原始MDP計算近似最優策略。此外，我們的因果抽象通常可以推廣到相關的大規模MDP模型。
